title: Trump Is Finally Eyeing an Exit From Iran. But Will He Take It?
partialText: President Trump says he is considering “winding down” operations in Iran. But many of his original war goals remain unaccomplished.

title: As War Disrupts India’s Gulf Ties, Economy Faces ‘New Broadside’
partialText: Generations of Indian workers and businesses have turned the Arab side of the Gulf into a vital appendage of their own country.

title: Israel Orders Military to Intensify Demolitions in Southern Lebanon
partialText: Defense Minister Israel Katz instructed troops to destroy more bridges and buildings in southern Lebanon, stoking worries that Israel could expand a military-controlled buffer zone there.

title: ICE to Help TSA at Airports Amid Partial Shutdown, Trump’s Border Czar Says
partialText: Tom Homan, President Trump’s chief border official, said plans were being drawn up to send immigration and customs agents to U.S. airports.

title: Mullin Explored Bipartisan Deal to Rein in Immigration Crackdown
partialText: The G.O.P. senator President Trump chose to lead the Department of Homeland Security privately discussed concessions the White House has repeatedly rejected.

title: News Outlets Pressure Pentagon to Restore Access After Court Ruling
partialText: A federal judge ruled on Friday that key parts of the Pentagon’s press policy were unconstitutional.

title: The Supreme Court Could Make it Harder to Vote by Mail in the Midterms
partialText: The Republican National Committee wants to toss ballots arriving after Election Day. Critics say thousands of votes — a majority cast by Democrats — are at stake.

title: How the Supreme Court Could Change Voting by Mail
partialText: The Supreme Court is ruling on whether ballots received after Election Day should be disqualified. Our national politics reporter Nick Corasaniti explains how a Supreme Court ruling could affect hundreds of thousands of Americans in rural and urban areas.

title: Beshear Criticizes Vance in Ohio, Stoking 2028 Presidential Tensions
partialText: Mr. Beshear, the Democratic governor of Kentucky, sharply criticized Mr. Vance as both angle for potential presidential runs.

title: California Could Elect a Republican Governor Thanks to the ‘Jungle Primary’
partialText: The state’s wide-open “jungle primary” has Democrats on edge.

title: Don Lemon on Trump, Minnesota and Streaming on YouTube
partialText: A Minnesota church protest made the former anchor a star again — and a target for the Trump administration.

title: The Billionaire Funding France’s Far Right
partialText: Pierre-Édouard Stérin is financing projects to make France less Muslim, more Catholic and more capitalist. He says his program has trained thousands running for municipal office on Sunday.

title: France Is Voting for Thousands of New Mayors. Here’s Why It Matters.
partialText: The far-right party had first-round successes in several cities, but so did the far left. Sunday’s second round may clarify who has real momentum.

title: Trump Has Made a Fundamental Miscalculation about Iran
partialText: America shouldn’t fight a war like this.

title: The End of the Free-Range ‘Stand by Me’ Childhood
partialText: What a 40-year-old movie told me about childhood today.

title: Introducing the Robot Umpire
partialText: We explain a technological change that’s about to transform baseball.

title: Fearing Chaos of Climate Change, Some Seek Answers in Virtual Classroom
partialText: A monthlong seminar offers lessons in how to anticipate and prepare for the mounting disruptions of global warming

title: Italy’s Leader Wants to Change the Constitution. Italians Don’t Get It.
partialText: Voting starts Sunday on a referendum to overhaul Italy’s judiciary. Many people don’t understand the complex proposal — and it could hurt Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni.

title: Not All Malls Are Struggling
partialText: A certain type of shopping mall has become a surprising bright spot for real estate investors.
